name: Wait Until Spring
source:
One white rose stood tall against the blizzard. A lone soldier in a battleground.

She always had hope that one day, I would be allowed out. That one day I could touch that rose.

If I could just wait until spring.

[From [url=https://summer-light-studios.itch.io/wait-until-spring]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一朵白玫瑰在暴风雪中高高矗立。战场上的孤独士兵。

她一直希望有一天，我能被允许出去。有一天我可以触摸那朵玫瑰。

如果我能等到春天就好了。

[来自[url=https://summer-light-studios.itch.io/wait-until-spring]itch.io[/url]]
